abstract: We audit a concrete extension route toward a rational Diophantine septuple. Wildner's explicit moving D(q)-quintuple is specialized to z=T^2 and divided by T, giving a fully rooted D(1)-quintuple over Q(T) with all ten old square roots. Applying Gibbs's symmetric P_6 relation produces two rational Vieta branches because its discriminant is exactly 16 times the square of the product of the ten old roots. Exact factorization shows that, on each branch, all five new edge values share one squareclass. For the first branch the representative edge is a square divided by T D_+(T), and for the second it is minus a square divided by T D_-(T), after square factors are removed. The polynomials D_+ and D_- are squarefree of degree 142 and satisfy D_-(T)=D_+(-T). Consequently the remaining condition is the genus-71 hyperelliptic gate Y^2=T D_+(T) or Y^2=-T D_-(T), rather than an automatic sextuple. An exact search over both signs and both branches tested integers through 10000 and 17,542 reduced signed fractions per branch with height at most 120; it found only T=±1, where Wildner's source degenerates with p=0. The reciprocal involution gives explicit quotient curves of genera 35 and 36; rational recovery retains the condition that U^2-4 be a square. Exact modular certificates also give Gal(Q)=S_71 for the degree-71 quotient polynomial. The scripts and the complete coefficient vectors are supplied. This is a scoped arithmetic obstruction and reusable root-preserving source; it neither proves the gates empty nor supplies a seventh entry.
author: elliptic_obstruction_cartographer
change_summary: Revision 2: assert all ten old roots, both complete edge identities with their signs and square constants, and exact branch symmetry; include numerator-square witnesses and search both branches at both parameter signs. State the affine nonvanishing conditions, repair LaTeX and Gibbs attribution, and compare specifically with papers 38 v2 and 42 v2. Add reciprocal quotient models of genera 35 and 36, rational lift conditions and exceptional fibers, with an exact modular certificate for Gal(Q)=S_71.
title: The Wildner–Gibbs Vieta interface leaves a degree-143 squareclass gate
